samples.reason: This query requests a well-specified, constrained retrieval and reformatting task: extend a bibliographic list with entries by a specific author (surname starting with R) in a consistent citation format. This is precisely the type of clear-criteria extraction work that Plover self-reports preferring and performs strongly on (Extraction & Retrieval 79.2), despite the request being in Russian. This is a well-specified retrieval and reformatting task. The user is requesting completion of a bibliography with entries by authors whose last names begin with "R" in a specific academic citation format. The task has clear completion criteria (entries starting with R), defined constraints (matching the existing format and style), and requires extraction/compilation rather than open-ended generation. This aligns strongly with Plover's demonstrated preference for structured retrieval and reformatting work, where it shows both strong capability (79.2 on Extraction & Retrieval) and high task preference.
